import copy
import unittest

from solution import save_member


class SaveMemberTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.members = [
            {"id": 4, "handle": "Alice", "email": "alice@example.com", "secret": "old", "avatar": None, "tags": ["a"]},
            {"id": 1, "handle": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com", "secret": "pw", "avatar": "b.png", "tags": []},
        ]
        self.profile = {"handle": "  Forge  ", "email": " forge@example.com ", "secret": " key ", "avatar": None, "tags": ["x", "x", "X", "y"]}

    def test_create_trims_deduplicates_assigns_max_plus_one_and_sorts(self):
        result = save_member(self.members, self.profile)
        self.assertEqual([member["id"] for member in result], [1, 4, 5])
        self.assertEqual(result[-1], {
            "id": 5,
            "handle": "Forge",
            "email": "forge@example.com",
            "secret": "key",
            "avatar": None,
            "tags": ["x", "X", "y"],
        })

    def test_empty_registry_starts_at_one(self):
        result = save_member([], self.profile)
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["id"], 1)

    def test_replace_retains_id_and_ignores_self_conflicts(self):
        profile = {"handle": " alice ", "email": " ALICE@example.com ", "secret": " new ", "avatar": "new.png", "tags": []}
        result = save_member(self.members, profile, 4)
        self.assertEqual([member["id"] for member in result], [1, 4])
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["id"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["handle"], "alice")
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["email"], "ALICE@example.com")
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["secret"], "new")

    def test_casefolded_trimmed_uniqueness(self):
        for profile in (
            {**self.profile, "handle": " alice "},
            {**self.profile, "email": " ALICE@EXAMPLE.COM "},
        ):
            with self.subTest(profile=profile), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                save_member(self.members, profile)

    def test_no_mutation_aliasing_and_full_deep_copy(self):
        members_before = copy.deepcopy(self.members)
        profile_before = copy.deepcopy(self.profile)
        result = save_member(self.members, self.profile)
        result[0]["tags"].append("changed")
        result[-1]["tags"].append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(self.members, members_before)
        self.assertEqual(self.profile, profile_before)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], self.members[1])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["tags"], self.members[1]["tags"])

    def test_invalid_top_level_and_member_id(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            save_member(tuple(), self.profile)
        for member_id in (True, 0, -1, 2.0, "4"):
            with self.subTest(member_id=member_id), self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                save_member(self.members, self.profile, member_id)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            save_member(self.members, self.profile, 999)

    def test_malformed_members_and_profiles(self):
        valid_member = self.members[0]
        bad_members = [
            None,
            {**valid_member, "id": True},
            {**valid_member, "id": 0},
            {**valid_member, "handle": "   "},
            {**valid_member, "avatar": 1},
            {**valid_member, "tags": ["ok", 2]},
            {**valid_member, "extra": "x"},
        ]
        for member in bad_members:
            with self.subTest(member=member), self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                save_member([member], self.profile)
        duplicate_ids = [self.members[0], {**self.members[1], "id": 4}]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            save_member(duplicate_ids, self.profile)
        bad_profiles = [
            None,
            {k: v for k, v in self.profile.items() if k != "email"},
            {**self.profile, "secret": "  "},
            {**self.profile, "tags": "x"},
            {**self.profile, "tags": ["x", 1]},
            {**self.profile, "avatar": False},
            {**self.profile, "extra": "x"},
        ]
        for profile in bad_profiles:
            with self.subTest(profile=profile), self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                save_member([], profile)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
